CAMEL RIDE
WHAT IS THE UNIQUE AND UNUSUAL WALK YOU CAN DO IN CABO?

A camel ride on the beach! Don't miss out on the fantastic opportunity to experience an amazing tour that you will remember for a lifetime. Come and enjoy a spectacular camel ride along the crystal clear waters and the majestic waves of the Pacific Ocean.

Immerse yourself in camel culture and learn about their history, anatomy, personality, keeping and training - get up close, petting and feeding these amazing creatures. Try our typical tacos and discover the authentic Mexican flavors of various sauces.

 
RAZER DESERT TOUR
-Explore the Baja California Sur desert on a new Polaris ATV vehicle with an experienced local guide leading the way.

-Explore canyons and mountain trails in a secluded natural area.

-This activity is ideal for couples, families and groups of friends.

-Safety is our top priority, we provide protective gear: helmet and a face bandana.

-This adventure includes a visit to the famous second arch of Cabo San Lucas located in Rancho San Cristobal

WHALE WATCH TOUR

Cabo San Lucas is one of the best places in the world to whale watch, as it is located on the migratory route of several species. During the winter months, from December to April, humpback and gray whales visit the warm waters of the Sea of Cortez to mate, give birth, and nurse their young.

​

Whale watching in Cabo San Lucas is an incredible experience, offering the opportunity to see these majestic creatures in their natural habitat. Local tour operators offer a variety of options for whale watching, such as boat and catamaran rides, as well as guided tours on kayaks and paddleboards.

GLAS BOTTOM BOAT

The Glass Bottom Boat Tour to the Arch in Cabo San Lucas is an unforgettable experience that offers a unique and spectacular view of the natural beauty of this tourist destination. The glass bottom boat allows you to see the vibrant and colorful coral reefs, along with a variety of marine life, including tropical fish and stingrays.

In addition, during the tour towards the Arch, which is a famous natural monument located at the tip of the Baja California peninsula, visitors can enjoy impressive views of the beaches and cliffs of Cabo San Lucas.

Once you arrive at the Arch, you can see the iconic rock formations that rise from the ocean, including the famous "Window" rock, which creates a natural arch in the middle of the sea.
